target_gates.description: Helmet, torso, arms, and legs form one complete readable armor shell.
Overlapping plates articulate coherently at the major joints.
At least one opening visibly proves empty interior volume and no wearer.
Grounded motion and an object consequence show independent agency.
An armored person, mannequin, robot, crop, or floating pieces do not substitute.
The full closed boundary is visible without cropped gaps.
The boundary conforms to a real surface with coherent perspective.
Inside and outside regions show a visible state difference.
The effect stops, bends, or changes exactly at the boundary line.
A portal ring, rug, halo, glyph cloud, or copied ritual diagram does not substitute.
